$comment: Web Search Plus v4.0.0 example config — source-only search routing plus extraction-capable provider settings (incl. opt-in SerpBase and Keenable)

serpbase.$comment: SerpBase is explicit/fallback-only. To include in auto-routing, append 'serpbase' to auto_routing.provider_priority.

keenable.$comment: Keenable is lowest-priority: it never displaces a configured keyed provider. allow_public=true opts in to the keyless shared public tier (~1000 req/hour, no SLA); WSP_KEENABLE_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1 works too.

locale.$comment: Default country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and language (ISO 639-1; 'auto' enables conservative query language inference) for locale-aware providers (Serper, Brave, Querit, Firecrawl, You.com, SearXNG). Explicit query location hints (e.g. 'restaurantes Madrid') override the country. Env: WSP_LOCALE_COUNTRY / WSP_LOCALE_LANGUAGE.

quality.$comment: Extra spam/mirror domains to remove from results, and domains to rescue from the builtin blocklist (exact domain or true subdomains only).
